fields.PRODUCT NAME: Hand-Painted Rajasthani Marble Wall Clock – Traditional Meenakari Design
fields.DESCRIPTION: Add timeless elegance to your home with this exquisite Rajasthani marble wall clock, intricately hand-painted with Meenakari and Kundan-style artwork. The square frame highlights a detailed floral and geometric pattern in vibrant red, gold, and green hues, adorned with delicate stonework that reflects the opulence of Rajasthan’s royal heritage.
